title: Molecular Distributions of the Protostellar Envelope and the Outflow of IRAS 15398-3359: Principal Component Analysis
question: Can PCA characterize, without preconception, the distributions of 15 molecular lines and the continuum around the Class 0 protostar IRAS 15398-3359 on outflow and disk/envelope scales?

data.angular_resolution: Cycle 3 continuum 0.48x0.45 arcsec; Cycle 2 continuum 0.21x0.15 arcsec

recipe.method: CLEAN with Briggs weighting, continuum subtraction in uv, smooth to 0.5" beam, make moment 0 maps
Diagonalize correlation matrix of 16 (whole) or 15 (disk/envelope) images using pixels above 3 sigma in both distributions
Non-LTE LVG analysis of H2CO lines at blobs A-D and center
RADEX at c-C3H2 peaks using H2CO Ka=0 only

evidence.quote: PC1 and PC2 have the two largest contribution ratios, 42.1 % and 20.3 %, respectively.
PC1 and PC2 have the two largest contribution ratios, 42.1 % and 20.3 %, respectively.
On the disk/envelope scale, PC1 and PC2 stand for 76.7 % of the contribution ratio.
The derived gas kinematic temperature ranges from 43 K to 63 K (Table [8](#tempvalue)).
The ratios for the northwestern and southeastern sides are from 0.2 to 0.3 and from 0.1 to 0.2, respectively.

not_stated_but_needed: line-free channels and velocity ranges for moment 0 maps
clean masks, thresholds, and cell size
spectral setup of Cycle 2 in detail
LVG/RADEX collision data, density and line-width assumptions for the blob temperature fits
image regions/pixel selection for the two PCA scales
missing_for_reproduction: line-free channels and moment integration ranges
score_reason: Imaging recipe partly given and PCA well described, but calibration, moment ranges and LVG setup missing.
rediscovery_reason: Archival data, PCA fully described, numeric tables of correlation matrices and eigenvalues available for checking.
